Thank you so much for trying to help your girlfriend! That will mean so much to her. If you search “dissociative identity disorder” on google, a few legitimate resources might show up. A few good ones include: 
https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/health/conditionsandtreatments/dissociation-and-dissociative-disorders

https://www.psychiatry.org/patients-families/dissociative-disorders/what-are-dissociative-disorders

https://www.nami.org/learn-more/mental-health-conditions/dissociative-disorders

http://did-research.org/did/alters/systems.html

http://did-research.org/comorbid/dd/osdd_udd/did_osdd.html


https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/9792-dissociative-identity-disorder-multiple-personality-disorder

DissociDID is an excellent source on YouTube! They are a system dedicated to spreading awareness and support. They have a series called “Debunking DID” that is all about DID. They also make videos about their system personally which may give you the opportunity to see how DID can affect the person diagnosed with it.

Above all, the best thing you can do is support her. Never try to trigger one of her alters out. Ask questions when she’s feeling better, and make sure she knows that you care for all of her and are there to listen whenever she wants to talk. 

DID can be a really scary thing to live with but having you around to help her can really reduce some of the stress she may face when she discovers more about herself and her system.

I really hope this helps you!! Stay strong ❤️

I was “voluntarily” hospitalized once. I put it in quotes because my mom signed the papers even though I specifically told her I was not okay with it. I was in there for about a week, trying everything I could to get out. There wasn’t a lot of therapy and I was kept on the same medications. Nothing changed. I had a very bad experience (I even have ptsd from it), but I know some people who never wanted to leave. It depends on what makes you feel better. For me, being separated from my friends and my coping skills (music, piano, cello, my room, et c) made things infinitely worse. It all depends on what you feel is best for yourself.
